address: 215B37 Nguyen Van Huong Street, An Khanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 71107, Vietnam
bio: Opened in 2022, this BOM Hospitality Group restaurant has a dimly lit interior, making the open kitchen a focal point. Chef Kiên Phan blends traditional and modern, crafting dishes that reflect a deep respect for Vietnamese culture. The à la carte menu revolves around the grill, and each tasting menu has its own theme. Over 100 wine labels, many natural, bolster the offering. Reservations are recommended for this refined experience.
